WITH source_events AS (
    SELECT
        EVENT:event_id::VARCHAR AS event_id,
        EVENT:gateway_id::VARCHAR AS gateway_id,
        EVENT:sensor_id::VARCHAR AS sensor_id,

        TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP_TZ(
            EVENT:timestamp::VARCHAR
        ) AS measured_at,

        EVENT:measurement_type::VARCHAR AS measurement_type,

        TRY_TO_DOUBLE(
            EVENT:value::VARCHAR
        ) AS value,

        EVENT:unit::VARCHAR AS unit,

        EVENT:_kafka_topic::VARCHAR AS kafka_topic,
        EVENT:_kafka_partition::INTEGER AS kafka_partition,
        EVENT:_kafka_offset::BIGINT AS kafka_offset,

        source_file,
        source_file_row,
        loaded_at

    FROM GREENHOUSE_ANALYTICS.RAW.SENSOR_EVENTS
),

ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY event_id
            ORDER BY
                loaded_at DESC,
                source_file DESC,
                source_file_row DESC
        ) AS event_rank

    FROM source_events
),

audited AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        IFF(
            event_id IS NOT NULL
            AND event_rank > 1,
            TRUE,
            FALSE
        ) AS is_duplicate,

        IFF(
            event_id IS NOT NULL
            AND gateway_id IS NOT NULL
            AND sensor_id IS NOT NULL
            AND measured_at IS NOT NULL
            AND measurement_type IS NOT NULL
            AND value IS NOT NULL
            AND unit IS NOT NULL,
            TRUE,
            FALSE
        ) AS is_valid

    FROM ranked
)

WITH readings AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM GREENHOUSE_ANALYTICS.GREENHOUSE_DBT_intermediate.int_sensor_readings
),

daily AS (

        measurement_date_utc,
        gateway_id,
        sensor_id,
        measurement_type,

        COUNT(*) AS reading_count,

        AVG(value) AS avg_value,

        MAX(measured_at_utc) AS last_measured_at_utc

    FROM readings

    GROUP BY
        measurement_date_utc,
        gateway_id,
        sensor_id,
        measurement_type,
        unit
)

WITH audit_events AS (
    SELECT
        *,

        COALESCE(
            TO_DATE(
                CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', measured_at)
            ),
            TO_DATE(
                CONVERT_TIMEZONE('UTC', loaded_at)
            )
        ) AS reporting_date_utc

    FROM GREENHOUSE_ANALYTICS.GREENHOUSE_DBT_intermediate.int_sensor_event_audit
),

quality_counts AS (
    SELECT
        reporting_date_utc,
        gateway_id,
        sensor_id,
        measurement_type,

        COUNT(*) AS raw_record_count,

        SUM(
            IFF(is_duplicate, 1, 0)
        ) AS duplicate_record_count,

        SUM(
            IFF(NOT is_valid, 1, 0)
        ) AS invalid_record_count,

        SUM(
            IFF(
                is_valid AND NOT is_duplicate,
                1,
                0
            )
        ) AS valid_unique_reading_count

    FROM audit_events

    GROUP BY
        reporting_date_utc,
        gateway_id,
        sensor_id,
        measurement_type
),

readings_with_previous AS (
    SELECT
        measurement_date_utc,
        gateway_id,
        sensor_id,
        measurement_type,
        measured_at_utc,

        LAG(measured_at_utc) OVER (
            PARTITION BY
                gateway_id,
                sensor_id,
                measurement_type

            ORDER BY
                measured_at_utc,
                event_id
        ) AS previous_measured_at_utc

    FROM GREENHOUSE_ANALYTICS.GREENHOUSE_DBT_intermediate.int_sensor_readings
),

daily_gaps AS (
    SELECT
        measurement_date_utc,
        gateway_id,
        sensor_id,
        measurement_type,

        MAX(
            DATEDIFF(
                'SECOND',
                previous_measured_at_utc,
                measured_at_utc
            )
        ) AS max_reading_gap_seconds

    FROM readings_with_previous

    GROUP BY
        measurement_date_utc,
        gateway_id,
        sensor_id,
        measurement_type
)

SELECT
    q.reporting_date_utc AS measurement_date_utc,

    q.gateway_id,
    q.sensor_id,
    q.measurement_type,

    q.raw_record_count,
    q.duplicate_record_count,
    q.invalid_record_count,
    q.valid_unique_reading_count,

    g.max_reading_gap_seconds

FROM quality_counts q

LEFT JOIN daily_gaps g
    ON q.reporting_date_utc = g.measurement_date_utc
   AND q.gateway_id = g.gateway_id
   AND q.sensor_id = g.sensor_id
   AND q.measurement_type = g.measurement_type

WITH rules AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM GREENHOUSE_ANALYTICS.GREENHOUSE_DBT.environmental_score_rules
),

hourly_readings AS (
    SELECT
        measurement_hour_utc,
        gateway_id,
        measurement_type,
        unit,
        avg_value
    FROM GREENHOUSE_ANALYTICS.GREENHOUSE_DBT_marts.fct_sensor_hourly
),

components AS (
    SELECT
        h.measurement_hour_utc,
        h.gateway_id,
        h.measurement_type,
        r.score_version,
        r.weight,

        IFF(
            h.avg_value IS NULL
            OR h.avg_value < r.valid_min
            OR h.avg_value > r.valid_max,
            NULL,
            100.0 * GREATEST(
                0.0,
                1.0 - CASE
                    WHEN h.avg_value < r.target_min
                    THEN
                        (r.target_min - h.avg_value)
                        / NULLIF(r.tolerance_below, 0)

                    WHEN h.avg_value > r.target_max
                    THEN
                        (h.avg_value - r.target_max)
                        / NULLIF(r.tolerance_above, 0)

                    ELSE 0.0
                END
            )
        ) AS component_score

    FROM hourly_readings h

    INNER JOIN rules r
        ON h.measurement_type = r.measurement_type
       AND h.unit = r.unit
),

hourly_scores AS (
    SELECT
        measurement_hour_utc,
        gateway_id,
        score_version,

        COUNT(*) AS component_rows,
        COUNT(DISTINCT measurement_type) AS metric_count,
        COUNT(component_score) AS valid_component_count,

        ROUND(
            SUM(component_score * weight)
            / NULLIF(SUM(IFF(component_score IS NOT NULL, weight, 0)), 0),
            2
        ) AS calculated_score,

        MAX(
            IFF(measurement_type = 'air_temperature',
                component_score, NULL)
        ) AS temperature_score,

        MAX(
            IFF(measurement_type = 'relative_humidity',
                component_score, NULL)
        ) AS humidity_score,

        MAX(
            IFF(measurement_type = 'soil_moisture',
                component_score, NULL)
        ) AS soil_score

    FROM components

    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)

SELECT
    measurement_hour_utc,
    gateway_id,
    score_version,

    IFF(
        metric_count = 3
        AND component_rows = 3
        AND valid_component_count = 3,
        calculated_score,
        NULL
    ) AS environmental_score,

    temperature_score,
    humidity_score,
    soil_score,

    metric_count,
    valid_component_count,

    IFF(
        metric_count = 3
        AND component_rows = 3
        AND valid_component_count = 3,
        'complete',
        'incomplete'
    ) AS status

FROM hourly_scores
